blocks.text: Portugal superstar Cristiano Ronaldo can return to the squad if he wishes, despite walking out on his teammates, said national team coach Jorge Jesus on Sunday. Jesus said Ronaldo can come back into the fold “if he wants to” after the team beat Norway without the veteran attacker to reach the Nations League quarterfinals. The dispute began last week when Jesus left 41-year-old Ronaldo on the bench for Portugal’s first win over Norway.
